name: com.zen.core
description: Base for Unity games in one package: Base.dll, DataManager, UI, currency, extensions, vibration, ads (AdMob + AdZative native waterfall, UMP, ATT, AppsFlyer, Taichi, review / update, splash, debug tools), IAP (Unity IAP), Firebase (Analytics, Remote Config, Crashlytics), screens (ScreenUtils) and Base > Hub. Optional SDKs switch their part off when missing.

name: com.zen.plugins.adzative
description: AdMob native ads (GMA Next-Gen SDK) in 5 formats drawn over the Unity view without losing focus: banner, MREC, interstitial, app open, rewarded. Pools, slots on Canvas RectTransforms, 15 layouts, per-placement analytics. Can run under a host waterfall (manualLoad + externalSdkInit), e.g. zen-unity Base AdZative.
